facts.fact: The document names the National Cyber Security Authority (NCSA) as the Supervisory Authority under Rwanda's Law No 058/2021 and has it receive breach reports and settle disputes under that law.

NCSA's Data Protection and Privacy Office published template standard contractual clauses for transfers abroad under Article 49 of Law No 058/2021, which also set 72-hour breach reporting to the authority.
The document states that transfers of personal data from Rwanda must comply with Article 49 of Law No 058/2021 of 13/10/2021, and the NCSA clauses are issued to meet that Article.
The National Cyber Security Authority published standard contractual clauses for personal data transfer outside Rwanda under Article 49 of Law No 058/2021.
